summary: Eni S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of treasury shares during May 28-29, 2026, as part of a buyback program approved by shareholders on May 6, 2026. The company acquired 1,771,356 shares (0.06% of share capital) at a weighted average price of €22.5816 per share, for a total consideration of ~€40 million. The buyback is intended to provide additional remuneration to shareholders beyond dividends. Since program commencement on May 8, Eni has repurchased 6,871,356 shares (0.23% of capital) for ~€160 million, now holding 3.09% of share capital. The filing reflects an open-market issuer buyback, not a tender offer. Watch for accelerated repurchase pace or program completion and potential impact on share count and EPS accretion.
